changes.value: compare the featurized matrix width against model.n_features_in_ before predict_proba, and carry --desc-set through screening.rank so the two sides can agree

hypothesis: screening.rank called featurize without desc_set, so it always used v1 while the trainer may have used v2; predicting anyway produced garbage rankings. A preflight that names the disagreeing widths turns silent corruption into an actionable failure.

failure_clusters: screening.rank :: ValueError: X has N features, but StandardScaler is expecting M

risk: The preflight refuses runs that used to proceed; a model with no n_features_in_ attribute is still allowed through.
scope_note: Mined from the OOM-fixed customisation traces: screening.rank failures whose stderr is a feature-count ValueError.
rollback: drop the width check in screening/predict.py and the --desc-set argument
